details: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest acquired $17 million in Circle (USDC stablecoin issuer) and $20 million in SpaceX shares following their Q2 earnings results.
title: Ark Invest Buys Circle and SpaceX Shares

details: Russian President Vladimir Putin has signed a landmark law that permits regulated retail cryptocurrency trading within Russia.
title: Russia Legalizes Regulated Retail Crypto Trading

details: The U.S. Senate's efforts to pass the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act have reached a standstill before the August recess, due to ongoing ethics debates and law enforcement concerns, leaving the legislation's future uncertain.
title: US Senate Stalls on CLARITY Act Before Recess

details: CryptoQuant reports that large holders ("whales") of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP are accumulating these assets, a pattern often observed during the late stages of a bear market, potentially signaling an upcoming market reversal.
title: Whales Accumulating BTC, ETH, XRP Signals Late Bear Market

details: Financial giants BlackRock, Visa, and Mastercard are reportedly backing Circle's new Arc blockchain, with a launch anticipated on September 16, aiming to bridge traditional finance with Web3 innovations.
title: BlackRock, Visa, Mastercard Back Circle's Arc Blockchain

details: Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMEX, posited that a burgeoning artificial intelligence (AI) bubble could be a catalyst to drive Bitcoin's price to $1 million.
title: Arthur Hayes Predicts $1M Bitcoin Amid AI Bubble

details: Bitcoin's price has struggled to break above the $64,300 level for the fourth consecutive time, showing a divergence from global stock markets that recently hit record highs.
title: Bitcoin Stalls Below $64,300 Despite Global Stock Rally

details: The probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike has climbed to 46% following warnings from Neel Kashkari regarding persistent inflation, a development that could negatively impact risk-on assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed Rate Hike Odds Rise as Kashkari Warns on Inflation

details: Spot Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have recorded $18.39 million in net inflows for the third consecutive week, increasing total net assets above $10.52 billion, despite Ethereum's slight pullback at the end of July.
title: Spot ETH ETFs See $18.39M Inflows for Third Week

details: Binance experienced a significant 518% week-over-week drop in stablecoin netflow, marking the largest structural move across tracked metrics. This, coupled with historical August seasonality showing a -1.87% median return for Ethereum, suggests potential liquidity and seasonal pressures on crypto markets.
title: Binance Stablecoin Netflow Plunges Amid August Headwinds
